stories.title: Jackson Koivun Wins 3M Open — 21-Year-Old Beats Scheffler in Third Pro Start

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun just beat the world No. 1 in his third pro start.

21 years old. Led Auburn to the NCAA title.
Bogey-free 66. Tournament-record -25.

Scottie Scheffler shot 63 and finished SECOND.

One of the great debut wins in PGA Tour history. #PGATour #3MOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jackson Koivun at the 3M Open:

🏆 Age: 21
🏆 Third professional start
🏆 Tournament-record 25-under
🏆 Won by 3 over world No. 1 Scheffler

He missed the cut in his first two starts.

Golf is a game of peaks. #PGATour #3MOpen

stories.title: Lucas Herbert Sets All-Time LIV Golf Scoring Record at 30-Under

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Lucas Herbert just set the all-time LIV Golf scoring record.

-30 at LIV UK. Previous record was -26.

He led wire-to-wire. Hatton was 6 back at -24.
Ripper GC swept the team title.

History at The Belfry. #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf UK final leaderboard:

🥇 Herbert — -30 (ALL-TIME RECORD)
🥈 Hatton — -24
🥉 DeChambeau — -21

Ripper GC: team title.

Herbert shattered the previous record by FOUR shots. #LIVGolf

She just won it again.

Back-to-back at Dundonald Links. -21, three clear of Hyo Joo Kim.

The AIG Women's British Open is next. #LPGA #WomensScottishOpen

stories.title: Scheffler's 2026 Drought — Five Runner-Ups, One Win for the World No. 1

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler in 2026:

❌ 0 wins at Bay Hill
❌ 0 wins at The Players
❌ 0 wins at Augusta
❌ 0 wins at the U.S. Open
❌ 0 wins at 3M Open

Just 1 win total — American Express in January.
5 runner-ups. World No. 1. Golf is strange. #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
Scheffler shot 63 today and lost to a 21-year-old in his third start.

7 wins in 2024. 6 wins in 2025.
1 win and 5 runner-ups in 2026.

"I think I've been really close to winning some tournaments, and that can be frustrating."

He's not wrong. #PGATour

stories.title: LIV Golf Financial Crisis — $400M Needed, Events at Risk

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf needs $400 million to complete its 2026 season.

PIF has spent $5.3B since 2022 — and is withdrawing.
Restructuring specialists are now on the board.
Multiple events described as "on the fence."

Bankruptcy is being considered. #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text:
Since 2022, Saudi Arabia's PIF spent over $5.3 billion building LIV Golf.

Now it's withdrawing.

LIV needs $400M to finish 2026. Events are at risk.
Gene Davis and Jon Zinman — restructuring specialists — are on the board.

The PGA Tour is watching. #LIVGolf #Golf

article.headline: LIV Golf Needs $400M to Finish Its 2026 Season — And It Doesn't Have It
